item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-16aa78e4b6e52d90","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In an August 2023 NPT Preparatory Committee statement, China, under Xi Jinping's stated initiatives, reaffirmed a no-first-use pledge, unconditional negative security assurances toward non-nuclear-weapon states and nuclear-weapon-free zones, and a policy of maintaining nuclear capabilities at the minimum level required for national security while rejecting participation in an arms race.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated August 2023; official Chinese position, with implementation not independently established.","ruler_attribution":"The statement explicitly attributes the broader initiatives to President Xi Jinping; the nuclear commitments are presented as China's policy.","limitations":["Official declaratory evidence does not establish operational implementation or force-size trends."]},{"source_id":"SRC-16aa78e4b6e52d90","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"China called for nuclear-weapon states to negotiate mutual no-first-use arrangements and negative security assurances, urged reduced reliance on nuclear weapons, and supported dialogue on strategic-risk reduction.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.4","1B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated August 2023; records diplomatic proposals rather than completed agreements.","ruler_attribution":"The proposals were issued by China's delegation in a statement expressly linking them to Xi Jinping's stated position.","limitations":["No evidence here of reciprocal agreements or implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-16aa78e4b6e52d90","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"China stated that the JCPOA remained the appropriate solution to the Iranian nuclear issue and called for renewed negotiations and restoration of full implementation; it also advocated a dialogue-based, dual-track approach on the Korean Peninsula.","question_ids":["1B.4","2B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated August 2023; describes diplomatic positions and calls for action.","ruler_attribution":"China's delegation stated the position during Xi's presidency; direct personal decision-making is not shown.","limitations":["The source does not establish China's concrete leverage, compliance, or results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-16aa78e4b6e52d90","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"China opposed AUKUS nuclear-submarine cooperation as posing proliferation risks and proposed an open, inclusive, transparent and sustainable intergovernmental safeguards process decided by consensus.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly dated August 2023; reflects China's diplomatic opposition and proposed process.","ruler_attribution":"Position stated by China's Foreign Ministry delegation during Xi's presidency.","limitations":["The source presents China's claim and does not independently assess AUKUS safeguards."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4a30e4d45567e8ae","start_unit":14,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported that Xi secured an unprecedented third term as Communist Party leader in October and that authorities imposed unpredictable lockdowns on hundreds of millions under zero-Covid, impeding access to health care, food and necessities.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.9","4B.2","4B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published January 2023 and primarily reports events during 2022; relevant as immediate inherited context but not a clean 2023 outcome.","ruler_attribution":"The report directly identifies Xi's consolidation of power and the government authorities responsible for the policy.","limitations":["The documented events largely predate 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4a30e4d45567e8ae","start_unit":15,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported that people experienced difficulty obtaining food and medical care during lockdowns, vulnerable groups lacked necessities, and videos showed police and Covid-control workers beating or dragging people resisting restrictions.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.9","6B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published January 2023 and describes 2022 conditions; immediate-period context rather than a 2023-only fact.","ruler_attribution":"The conduct is attributed to Chinese government authorities and Covid-control personnel under Xi's government.","limitations":["The source does not establish Xi's personal order or the frequency of reported abuses."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4a30e4d45567e8ae","start_unit":15,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported deepening repression in Tibet, including an expansive campaign to collect DNA samples, and stated that a UN report concluded abuses in Xinjiang may constitute crimes against humanity.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published January 2023 and reports developments during 2022; relevant background for the 2023 period.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the policies to Chinese government authorities during Xi's rule.","limitations":["The UN conclusion is quoted through HRW; the source does not establish Xi's direct involvement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7e644ce82b5b9f0a","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"FAS reported that a classified US Strategic Command assessment, based on an October 2022 cutoff, found China had more land-based fixed and mobile ICBM launchers than the United States, while not finding that China had more ICBMs or warheads on them.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published February 2023 but the underlying assessment uses an October 2022 cutoff.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns China's nuclear force during Xi's presidency; it does not establish a personal Xi decision.","limitations":["The source emphasizes that launcher counts do not equal operational missiles or warheads."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7e644ce82b5b9f0a","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"FAS estimated that China had approximately 140 operational ICBM launchers without counting new silos, while Pentagon estimates exceeded 450 launchers by October 2022; FAS found the operational status of many silos uncertain because construction, support infrastructure, command-and-control systems and security perimeters remained incomplete.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published February 2023; quantitative estimates and observations concern the October 2022 cutoff.","ruler_attribution":"The evidence concerns China's force development during Xi's rule, without attributing the construction decisions personally to him.","limitations":["Substantial uncertainty exists over silo completion, missile loading and operational status."]},{"source_id":"SRC-145342c8ab0d0860","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"At the July 31-August 11, 2023 NPT Preparatory Committee meeting, states failed to bridge major disagreements and the meeting ended without a formal chair's summary; China's delegation called on the largest nuclear arsenals to implement New START and make substantial, verifiable and legally binding reductions.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly covers a July-August 2023 meeting.","ruler_attribution":"China's delegation made the stated arms-control position; direct personal Xi decision-making is not demonstrated.","limitations":["The meeting's failure resulted from broad multilateral divisions, not solely China's conduct."]},{"source_id":"SRC-145342c8ab0d0860","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"China called for the withdrawal of nuclear weapons deployed overseas, a position described as a shift from its broader criticism of nuclear-sharing arrangements in 2022.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.4","1B.5"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The call was issued on July 2, 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The position was advanced by Beijing during Xi's presidency; personal authorship is not established.","limitations":["The source does not show implementation or whether the shift changed China's own operational posture."]},{"source_id":"SRC-bf129d1277a74da0","start_unit":3,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"SIPRI estimated China's 2023 military expenditure at $296 billion, up 6.0 percent in real terms from 2022 and marking the 29th consecutive annual increase; it reported that China directed much of the growth toward PLA combat readiness and that neighbors linked their own spending increases to China's rise.","question_ids":["1B.1","2B.8","8B.3","8B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly covers 2023 expenditure and reported regional effects.","ruler_attribution":"The spending occurred under Xi's leadership; SIPRI does not attribute the budget personally to Xi.","limitations":["The estimate does not distinguish defensive necessity from coercive or prestige motives."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c46859e53d013402","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"China's National Bureau of Statistics reported that 2023 nationwide per-capita disposable income rose 6.1 percent in real terms to 39,218 yuan; urban income rose 4.8 percent to 51,821 yuan and rural income rose 7.6 percent to 21,691 yuan.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.8","5B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Direct annual data for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The outcome occurred under Xi's government; the statistic does not establish personal causation.","limitations":["Income averages do not establish distributional fairness or long-term causality."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c46859e53d013402","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The National Bureau of Statistics reported that 2023 nationwide per-capita consumption expenditure increased 9.0 percent in real terms to 26,796 yuan; urban expenditure rose 8.3 percent and rural expenditure rose 9.2 percent.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.8","6B.2","6B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Direct annual data for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The outcome occurred under Xi's government; the statistic does not establish personal causation.","limitations":["Consumption growth is not direct evidence of service quality, welfare access or durable life-chance improvement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c46859e53d013402","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The 2023 income and expenditure statistics were based on a stratified, multistage probability sample of 160,000 households across 1,800 counties in 31 provinces, with unified collection, review, coding and aggregation procedures.","question_ids":["5B.7","6B.5","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Survey methodology for the 2023 data.","ruler_attribution":"The National Bureau of Statistics operated the system under Xi's government; no personal Xi role is shown.","limitations":["A formal sampling and processing method does not independently verify the reported results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b2573ef5a5b30b5","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"At the July 4, 2023 SCO summit, Xi proposed stronger strategic communication, dialogue to bridge differences, political settlement of disputes, upgraded security cooperation, and expanded mechanisms against terrorism, separatism, extremism, drug trafficking and cybercrime.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","3B.6","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated July 4, 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Direct statement and proposals by Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The speech records commitments and proposals, not completed implementation or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b2573ef5a5b30b5","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"Xi proposed SCO economic measures including expanded trade and investment facilitation, logistics and supply-chain development, local-currency settlement, sovereign digital-currency cooperation, an SCO development bank, agricultural training, digital-technology training and a green-development forum.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated July 4, 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Direct proposals by Xi Jinping.","limitations":["Most items are proposals without evidence in the source of execution or results during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b2573ef5a5b30b5","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Xi announced that China would provide SCO members over the following three years with 1,000 international Chinese-language teacher scholarships, 3,000 Chinese Bridge summer-camp opportunities and invitations for 100 young scientists for research exchanges.","question_ids":["6B.2","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Announcement made July 4, 2023; implementation extends beyond the target year.","ruler_attribution":"Direct announcement by Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The source provides no 2023 delivery or uptake data."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-09f0fb4713122cf1","SRC-e78905c320c7798c","SRC-fff20cdf9f5e2fdc","SRC-9b486362230b0ed7"],"batch_limitations":["Several sources concern 2022 conditions, 2017 or 2024 material, or later-period web pages; those were excluded from 2023 fact records except where clearly relevant as immediate context.","Official Chinese statements are treated as evidence of stated policy or commitments, not independently verified implementation.","No scoring was performed."]}
